title: Termwise sheafified ringed slice extension on cochain complexes
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a site small relative to the fixed module universe, let $R$ be a sheaf of commutative rings on $\mathcal C$, and let $U$ be an object. Write $(\mathcal C/U,R|_U)$ for the localized ringed site [def-pur-localized-ringed-site] and $\operatorname{Mod}(R)$, $\operatorname{Mod}(R|_U)$ for the categories of sheaves of modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Let $e_!:\operatorname{Mod}(R|_U)\to\operatorname{Mod}(R)$ be the extension-by-zero presheaf functor [def-weil-extension-by-zero-presheaf] followed by module sheafification [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification]. Its additive structure is the one supplied by the exact localized-site adjunction [lem-pur-site-restriction-module-adjunction-exact]. The termwise extension functor on integer-indexed, possibly unbounded cochain complexes [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules] sends $P^\bullet$ to the complex with degree $i$ term $e_!(P^i)$ and differential $e_!(d_P^i)$, and sends a chain map $f$ to the chain map with components $e_!(f^i)$. It is the functor obtained by applying $e_!$ to homological complexes of shape $\operatorname{up}(\mathbf Z)$.
